subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “The cafeteria let students vote for one new lunch menu item.”?
options: Instead of selling only fried food and sweet drinks, it added vegetable soup, fruit boxes, and rice balls.
Ben gave him half of the chicken, and Lily shared some fruit.
People can take small packets of vegetable or flower seeds for free.
The choices were curry rice, tomato noodles, vegetable dumplings, and chicken soup.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Instead of selling only fried food and sweet drinks, it added vegetable soup, fruit boxes, and rice balls.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Ben gave him half of the chicken, and Lily shared some fruit.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「People can take small packets of vegetable or flower seeds for free.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The choices were curry rice, tomato noodles, vegetable dumplings, and chicken soup.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
